---

**Minecraft 1.21.1 | NeoForge | Create Modpack**
> *Industry, ingenuity, and innovation — reimagined.*

**Create+ | Modern Edition** is a carefully curated NeoForge modpack built around **Create** — the mechanical wonder that turns gears, shafts, and contraptions into works of art. Pair it with **Steam 'n' Rails** for an expansive railway network, **Sophisticated Storage** and **Sophisticated Backpacks** for elegant organization, and a full suite of performance and quality-of-life mods that keep everything running silky smooth.

Whether you're building a sprawling industrial factory, a cozy automated farm, or a continent-spanning rail empire — this modpack gives you every tool you need.

---

![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/492b340adcb0df606912bdf248943a720ecafc73.png)

## 🔧 Automation & Transport
Build complex machinery, automate everything, and connect your world with a full railway network. Powered by **Create**, **Create Aeronautics**, **Steam 'n' Rails**, and a suite of Create add-ons covering electricity, diesel engines, enchanting, cooking, and more.

## 📦 Storage & Logistics
Keep your base organized with **Sophisticated Storage** and **Sophisticated Backpacks** — both deeply integrated with Create. Upgrade your chests, barrels, and backpacks with filters, sorting, and auto-crafting. Never lose track of your items again.

## ✨ Quality of Life
From **JEI** for recipe lookup to **Jade** for block info, **LambDynamicLights** for immersive lighting, and **Leaves Be Gone** for cleaner tree chopping — every small annoyance has been addressed.

## 🗺️ Navigation
**Xaero's Minimap** and **Xaero's World Map** keep you oriented across your world with waypoints, cave maps, and a full-screen map view.

## ⚡ Performance
**Sodium**, **Iris Shaders**, **ModernFix**, **Ferrite Core**, **ImmediatelyFast**, and **Entity Culling** work together to keep the game fast and smooth — even with shaders enabled.

---

## 🖥️ PC Requirements

| | 🔴 Minimum | ⭐ Recommended | 🟢 High-end |
|---|---|---|---|
| **CPU** | i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 2600 | i7-10700 / Ryzen 7 3700X | i7-13700K / Ryzen 9 7900X |
| **GPU** | GTX 1060 6GB / RX 580 | RTX 2060 / RX 6600 XT | RTX 3080 / RX 7800 XT+ |
| **RAM** | 8 GB (6 GB to Java) | 16 GB (8 GB to Java) | 32 GB (12 GB to Java) |
| **Storage** | HDD · 4 GB free | SSD · 4 GB free | NVMe SSD · 4 GB free |
| **Java** | Java 21 (64-bit) | Java 21 (64-bit) | Java 21 (64-bit) |
| **FPS** | 40–80 fps | 80–200 fps | 200+ fps |

> **Java 21 required** — set `-Xmx` to your allocated RAM in your launcher (e.g. `-Xmx8G`).

---

*Requires NeoForge for Minecraft 1.21.1 · All mods included — no manual downloads needed.*
